# GradTensor

> Governed AI automation for the businesses that make, build, move, and maintain physical things.

GradTensor brings governed AI automation to the physical economy - manufacturing, construction, distribution, and industrial services, manufacturing first. We put AI to work across operations, from back-office paperwork to plant-floor maintenance and root-cause analysis, always under human control. Based in India, founded as a venture of Sudhanva Labs LLP.

## What we do

### Assess - The Judgment Line Assessment
- We map your operations and identify exactly where AI belongs, and where it must not go
- Output: a prioritised view of hours to win back and the work that must stay with your people

### Train - Executive alignment and team training
- Align leadership on what AI can and cannot do in your business
- Hands-on training for teams to use AI safely in real operations

### Implement - Governed AI assistants, built on Forge
- Office and document workflows: enquiries, quotes, BOMs, tenders, supplier documents, quality paperwork, service reports
- Plant-floor needs: predictive-maintenance support, root-cause analysis, and knowledge assistants over machine manuals and maintenance procedures
- Every assistant runs with a human in control and a full audit trail on every decision

## The Judgment Line

Our method for drawing the line between what AI carries and what stays with your people. Final quality sign-off, contractual and pricing commitments, safety-critical decisions, and final verification never cross the line. This is what makes the automation governed and safe for a risk-aware operation.

## Forge

Our platform for building and deploying governed AI assistants for operations - the proof that we can implement, not a product to buy off the shelf.
